author: TropicalCrayon
body: I was banned for rudeness and spam. I joined the server with my new friends to play minecraft PvP games and I got kicked for asking to help when I got stuck spawning on the observer platform. I feel I do not deserve a temporary player ban  for rudeness and spam because I did neither of those things! If you can check the chat logs it will show you that all I did was ask for help and talk to my friends.
